name: Lion
intro: A lion is a big wild cat. It lives in a family group called a pride.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A lion is a big, strong cat.
Its fur is yellow and gold.
A grown-up boy lion has a big, furry mane.
A lioness does not have a mane.
Baby lions have light spots on their fur.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Most lions live in Africa.
They live on grassy lands called savannas.
A few lions live in a forest in India.
Lions live in groups called prides.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Lions are carnivores, so they eat meat.
They hunt zebras and antelope.
The lionesses do most of the hunting.
They often hunt together in small groups.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: Baby lions are called cubs.
A mom lion has a few cubs at a time.
Cubs drink their mom's milk.
Other moms in the pride help care for the cubs.
Cubs start to eat meat at about 3 months old.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Lions are the only big cats that live in groups.
Lions sleep or rest most of the day.
A lion's roar can be heard far away.
Lions are good at climbing trees.
Each lion has its own pattern of whisker spots.

vocab.meaning: Long, thick hair around a lion's head and neck.
